Project: FreshlyToo Mobile App Landing Page
Role: SEO & Content Strategy


Objective: Optimize the landing page for search engines to drive organic traffic from both eco-conscious consumers and business owners looking to reduce food waste and increase revenue.

1. Target Keywords
To capture our dual-sided market, the content and meta tags must integrate the following primary and secondary keywords naturally:

B2C (Consumers): "discounted food app", "prevent food waste", "eco-friendly meals", "cheap food near me", "sustainable lifestyle", "ucuz yemek uygulaması", "indirimli taze yemek", "gıda israfını önle".

B2B (Businesses): "restaurant surplus food", "sell unsold food", "food waste management for bakeries", "increase restaurant revenue", "restoran ek gelir", "satılamayan yemekleri değerlendirme".

2. Meta Tags (For <head> section)
Title Tag: FreshlyToo | Save Surplus Food, Stop Waste (Optimal length: under 60 characters).

Meta Description: Rescue fresh, unsold food from nearby restaurants and bakeries at a discount. Protect your budget and the planet. Turn business losses into revenue with AI-powered listings. (Optimal length: ~150-160 characters).


Alt Texts for Images: All images, especially the vibrant green-themed app mockups, must have descriptive alt texts (e.g., alt="FreshlyToo app map view showing discounted meals nearby").

3. Semantic HTML and Heading Hierarchy (H1, H2, H3)
The UI/UX Designer and Developer must strictly follow this semantic structure to ensure search engines understand the page content:

4. Technical SEO Requirements for Developer (Agent 4)

Semantic Tags: Use <section>, <article>, and <nav> appropriately instead of generic <div> tags to improve accessibility and SEO.

Performance: Fast loading times are a ranking factor. Ensure all image mockups are compressed (e.g., WebP format).

Mobile-First: Since this is a mobile app landing page, the design and layout must be heavily optimized for mobile devices.


Accessibility (a11y): Ensure strong color contrast (especially with the green theme) and proper ARIA labels for static buttons containing hover/click animations.
